proposition.object:
## What are the current Kalshi odds?

Odds as of October 3, 2026 at 20:15 UTC. Each price is the middle of the bid and the ask, read as a probability; the market lists 3 outcomes and 677 thousand contracts traded in the last 24 hours.

- **Mexico**: 42% (bid 41 cents, ask 42 cents; 299 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **USA**: 36% (bid 35 cents, ask 36 cents; 322 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **Tie**: 25% (bid 24 cents, ask 25 cents; 56 thousand contracts in 24 hours)

Prices change with every trade; the [live Kalshi market](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxintlfriendlygame/international-friendly-game/kxintlfriendlygame-26oct03usamex) is the current figure.

## What is our view?

We have no model of our own for this market, so the odds above are the traders' consensus and not an independent estimate. For calibration: in our sample of settled Sports markets, the Kalshi mid-price a day before close scored a Brier error of 0.1738 (a coin-flip price scores 0.25; lower is better).

## How does this market resolve?

> If USA wins the USA vs Mexico professional Intl Friendlies soccer game originally scheduled for Oct 3, 2026 after 90 minutes plus stoppage time (does not include extra time or penalties), then the market resolves to Yes.

Close: October 6, 2026 at 02:00 UTC. Expected settlement: October 4, 2026 at 05:00 UTC. Settlement source: [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/). Full terms: [Kalshi contract terms](https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/SOCCERGAMEWIN.pdf).

## What could move the odds?

- Lineup and injury news, and the live game state once play starts.
- Postponement or cancellation under the rules' fair-price clause.
- A rules clarification or settlement-source change published by Kalshi on the market page.
- Order-book depth: thin books move on small orders, so a large price move on little volume says little.

## How reliable are markets like this one?

Across 537 settled Sports markets in our sample (Kalshi, 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-03), the Kalshi mid-price about 24 hours before close had a Brier error of 0.1738; a coin-flip price scores 0.25 and lower is better. Contracts quoted at 5 cents or less settled YES 3.3% of the time (30 markets); contracts quoted at 95 cents or more settled YES 100.0% (17 markets). The sample covers a few weeks, so it is a guide to how markets like this have behaved, not a guarantee of how this one will settle.

## Frequently asked questions

### What are the odds on "USA vs Mexico"?

As of October 3, 2026 at 20:15 UTC, Kalshi implies Mexico at 42%, USA at 36%, and Tie at 25%. These move with every trade; the live market is at https://kalshi.com/markets/kxintlfriendlygame/international-friendly-game/kxintlfriendlygame-26oct03usamex.

### What does a price on Kalshi mean as a probability?

A contract that pays $1 if the outcome happens and trades at 45 cents implies about a 45% chance, before fees and ignoring the small gap between the bid and the ask. We take the middle of the bid and the ask.

### When does this market close and settle?

It closes October 6, 2026 at 02:00 UTC and is expected to settle October 4, 2026 at 05:00 UTC, in about 9 hours from the time of writing.

### Where does the settlement data come from?

Kalshi names ESPN (https://www.espn.com/) as the settlement source. The full contract terms are at https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/SOCCERGAMEWIN.pdf.

### Can I bet on this on Kalshi?

### Is this financial advice?

No. This wire reports a market's odds and its publisher's analysis from public information. Prediction-market contracts can lose their entire price.
